description: PA derives that the specified history program appends its next step output to the actual preceding history.
signature:
Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.PAComputations.history_successor_derives {n : ℕ}
  (h : Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.PAComputations.Program (n + 2)) :
  Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.PAComputations.PAEquivalent
    ((Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.history h).comp
        (Fin.snoc (fun i => Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.PAComputations.Program.proj i.castSucc)
          (Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.PAComputations.Program.succ.comp
            ![Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.PAComputations.Program.proj (Fin.last n)]))).graph
    (Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.listAppend.comp
        ![Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.history h,
          Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.listCons.comp
            ![h.comp
                (Fin.snoc (fun i => Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.PAComputations.Program.proj i)
                  (Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.history h)),
              Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.constant 0]]).graph
